label: LynxJS (Vue 3, Sparkling host)
buildGate: npm run build && xcodebuild -workspace ios/SparklingGo.xcworkspace -scheme SparklingGo -configuration Debug -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" build
releaseBuildGate: npm run build && xcodebuild -workspace ios/SparklingGo.xcworkspace -scheme SparklingGo -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" build
deviceBuildGate: npm run build && xcodebuild -workspace ios/SparklingGo.xcworkspace -scheme SparklingGo -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath "$TE_ARCHIVE" -derivedDataPath "$TE_DERIVED" archive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=''
